name: flathunter
what_it_holds: Python/Docker bot that scrapes live listings from ImmoScout24, Immowelt, WG-Gesucht, Kleinanzeigen (Germany), Idealista, Immobiliare, Subito (Italy/Spain) and pushes new-listing alerts via Telegram/Slack/Mattermost/Apprise. name: HomeHarvest
what_it_holds: Python library (MIT, 739 stars, 288 commits) that scrapes Realtor.com (not actually Zillow/Redfin despite topic tagging) for MLS-style listing data: address, MLS ID, listing status, beds/baths/sqft, list/sold price, price-per-sqft, HOA fees, list/sold/last-update dates, coordinates, county, nearby schools, agent/broker info, tax history and assessment values. Outputs to CSV/Excel/Pandas/JSON.
why_useful: One-command pull of current US rental asking-price listings by metro from Realtor.com; usable to build a point-in-time LTR panel for host-supply-economics / STR<->LTR crossover work (gap 13). No historical data bundled -- would need to be run repeatedly going forward, so cannot backfill.
